lines.text: We are on our way to Enikk's room after getting her call.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Feels like we've been wandering around without really accomplishing anything.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Tell me about it!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: But hey, at least it proves Liveryn wasn't lying

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: and that she's tight as heck with Sixo.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: The Dark Net was shut down, right?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Yeah, that means Sixo was actually inside that busted computer.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... But something tells me this isn't over.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Yeah, me too.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: Got a minute? I have something to report.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Aah! You almost gave me a heart attack!

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: Moran's done with treatment. Not that there was much to fix.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: Sugar's injuries are worse than they looked, so she's still being treated. The bike is in the shop too.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Is there even a proper Repair Center in the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: There is. It's illegal, but it's reliable, so relax.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: That makes absolutely no sense!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What about Liveryn?

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: She's with the other members of Cafe Sweety.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: They're going through Enikk's blind spots in the Ark, one at a time.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: Liveryn's taking the lead, and Cafe Sweety's installing surveillance cameras.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: Think of it as clearing out the blind spots in the Ark, once and for all.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: It's kinda weird that you suddenly bring up Cafe Sweety.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: With Sugar involved, they probably couldn't just sit back.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: The work's going smoothly. In about two weeks, Enikk won't have any blind spots left in the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Eh... feels like it's both good and bad.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Anyway, what's Exotic up to now?

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: We're currently working with the Peony Association to take down the Mist production facilities.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: Hedonia and Seimeikai will be joining soon, so this should wrap up quickly.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}, thanks for the help.
I didn't do much, anyway.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: Just having you with us lifts morale. It's like having a rock-solid ally behind us.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: I didn't get a chance to say this before, but thank you for helping Crow.

lines.speaker: eh_n_op_r
lines.text: Well then, I'll get in touch again if anything comes up.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: All right... so, what's the plan now?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We should meet Enikk first and decide our next move.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Excuse me.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Speak of the devil.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: The Dark Net, which had been shut down, is now back online.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Just as I thought.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: However, there is a network delay, rendering it unstable.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: The hardware you destroyed is assessed to have been Sixo's core hardware.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: It is likely hardware repeatedly modified to allow her to utilize her abilities to their full extent.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Sixo is still alive, though her capabilities are likely diminished.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: She may be using relatively lower-performance hardware as her core hardware,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: or distributing her functions across multiple units that complement each other.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: How do we shut her down for good?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Calculating...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: There is no definitive solution at this time.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Can't you, like, find Sixo with your super AI search thing?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Negative, that is impossible.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Ugh, what a pain...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Terrorist attack detected.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Terrorist attacks using E2 Crystals are occurring simultaneously at five locations.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Excuse me while I respond to the attacks.
*Whirr*
Is she showing off that she's still alive?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Let's help wherever we can. Enikk doesn't give a damn if people die.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander, have Enikk locate the nearest terrorist attack area—

lines.speaker: teeteringcitizen
lines.text: Aaarghhhhh!
I look toward the source of the scream.
... A man is running toward me, terrified.
No way...

lines.speaker: teeteringcitizen
lines.text: R-run! Runnnnn!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Damn it! Here too?!
Our eyes meet. I see the fear in his gaze.
He grabs me and cries out, his eyes pleading.

lines.speaker: teeteringcitizen
lines.text: You! You're the Commander, right?

lines.speaker: teeteringcitizen
lines.text: O-of the Commando Unit or whatever, right?!
Please stay calm. We'll handle it.

lines.speaker: teeteringcitizen
lines.text: Th-thank goodness!

lines.speaker: teeteringcitizen
lines.text: I'm so glad I found you!
The man raises his arm,
and my eyes follow his hand.
A glass bottle rests in his hand.
Inside, a crystal glimmers as circuits flash across it.
*Shatter!*
The glass breaks,
and the crystals scatter in every direction.
Only then do I take a good look at the man's face. His eyes are glazed, and drool runs down his chin. A Mist addict.
Rapi and Anis dash toward me.
I push off the ground, shoving them back with everything I've got.
*Craaaaaaack!*
The crystal shoots out,
trapping the man who just threw it right in place.
He doesn't move at all, probably already dead.
*Crack, crack!*
I glance around, only to find the crystals are extending toward us fast.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander! Are you all right?
I-I'm fine.
I glance around rapidly. Crystals shoot up, surrounding us like a cage.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Shit! We're trapped!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Tch...!
Rapi takes aim with her Seven Dwarves Zero.
Don't shoot! The shards will fly everywhere!
Straight ahead, text appears on a flickering monitor inside the shop.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Sixo.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Since you've gone through the trouble, I thought I'd repay you in my own way.
You even went after civilians... That's way more despicable than I thought!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: The Commando Unit is such a nuisance.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: So I figured it was better to get you out of the way while I had the chance.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Don't worry, you won't be alone.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Mint, Prika, and Avistar will be joining you soon.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: You son of a...!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: And not just them, {AccountData.NickName}. Every Nikke, every human connected to you.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I'll send them all along with you.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: That's fine, right? I mean, it's better when everyone goes together.
I'll catch you, no matter what.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: And how exactly do you plan to do that?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Losing my core hardware is a bit unfortunate, I'll admit,

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: but I'm everywhere.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: That's immortality in the truest sense.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: You can't catch me. Ever.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: And neither can Enikk.
*Craaaack!*

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Oh my, the E2 Crystals are expanding. How frightening.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: It was a pleasure meeting you.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Farewell.
*Crack*
The monitor shudders as crystals burst upward, then the screen goes black.
She really gets on my nerves!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Hang tight, Commander.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Rapi and I will get you out.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: So you better make sure we all get out of this in one piece too. Got it?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I trust you.
What if a shard hits your head?
And... Rapi doesn't have NIMPH anymore.
I'll find a way through, so you two just get out—
*Crack!*
*Crack, crack!*

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: What the heck... is that sound?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It... sounds like the crystals are breaking.
*Crack, crack, crack, crack!*
The sound is getting closer.
We all watch with bated breath.
*Crack, crack, crack, crack!*

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Firepower! Firepower!
And there's Neon,
approaching as she tears through the crystals with her bare hands.
*Crack, crack!*

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Firepower! Firepower!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: The?!
Hell?!
*Crack, crack!*
Neon spots us and waves at us cheerfully.
Just when she is about to punch the crystals between us, she suddenly stops.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Right, it'd be bad if these shards get everywhere!
Neon wraps her arms around the crystal as it rises, and my chest drops with a sickening jolt.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hup... There!
*Snap*
Neon twists the crystal she's holding and snaps it off, leaving only the base behind.
She points to the cleared path behind her.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: All right! I've cleared a path! Let's go!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: In the?!
World?!
One hour ago, at M.M.R. Level P.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: There we go.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: How does it feel, having a new body?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Hello? Anybody home?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Why isn't she responding? Ether, did you touch something you shouldn't have?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No, there's no way.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I simply followed the blueprint, that's all.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Then what's wrong with her?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'm just thinking.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Should I keep living as Neon, or become Neo-Neon?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Do as you wish.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So, what new powers do I have now that I'm Neo-Neon?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Tell her, Ether.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: You're healthy now.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: But... that doesn't sound new.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: What I mean is, your body is now impervious to any external interference.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No matter what happens, your body won't change—at least, not from anything that currently exists.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: That... doesn't sound new, either. Isn't that normal?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: You're immune to corruption.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oooh!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: In theory, even E2 Crystals and Dark Matter can't affect your body. I'm not sure about Vapaus, though.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Ooooooh!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No external substance can enter your body at all.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oooooooooooh!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Does that mean I'm basically indestructible?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: More like you're immune to everything.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What exactly are you two going on about?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'm actually all healthy now...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: What else?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: That's all there is.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Your body itself has become a key.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Ether.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: In short, your body now holds the essence of lost technology.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: That's enough.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: If she knew how precious her body is, wouldn't she take care of it?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Then what about these glasses?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: They don't have any special functions anymore. The light doesn't work, and BOOM doesn't run either.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Those things have been completely transferred to your body, so now your glasses are just... a sturdy pair of glasses.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Well, that's a bit of a bummer. I really liked using Vision Eye.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Also,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: the repaired D.E.E.P. outside are yours to command however you please.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: To them, the key is basically a royal seal.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: So, what do you want to do?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: For now... mind if they hang around here for a bit?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I just need to sort things out with Anis first, then I'll come back and decide.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: You do realize M.M.R. isn't a hotel, don't you?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oh, come on! Don't act like you didn't gain anything from me!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: While building me, the over-the-top Neo-Neon, I'm sure you've picked up plenty of tech along the way.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Hmm... you've got a point.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So, I think it's only fair that I ask for this much, right?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Fine, do as you like.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'll be back before you know it!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Mind showing me the way out?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: *Sigh* Ether, would you mind?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Suuure!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oh, just a sec.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What now?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So, does this mean I'm part of Missilis now? Just saying, I'm not really into shady corporations.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Naturally. After all, we made you.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: If my boss finds out, she's definitely not letting this slide.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Missilis actually stealing an Elysion Nikke and building her a new body? That's tactically unforgivable.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I mean, this is the kind of thing that escalates into a corporate war, isn't it?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: That makes sense. I'll discuss it with Ingrid and see if we can work it out.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oh? That was easier than I thought.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Sounds like the tech you got from building me really won you over.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Now, please go. You're far too noisy.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: You're really coming back?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: You bet!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Good, I'd really like you to return.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: You're just itching to take me apart, aren't you?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Yep, the blueprint's completely erased.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: It disappeared as soon as we started making your body.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: There wasn't even time to back it up.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: That's why Jien's being so nice to you. If we'd had the blueprint... well, you'd already be out the door.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Oops, Jien told me not to say that. My bad.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So that means I can get a little full of myself, huh?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: By all means, get all smug. You're the one holding the reins.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Gah, you being this nice is making me super uneasy!

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I kinda need to stay in your good graces too.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: You know, that tech in your body? In a way, it's humanity's long-awaited breakthrough.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: For Nikkes, it's immunity to corruption.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: For humans, it's immunity to all diseases.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: So maybe that kind of era isn't just wishful thinking anymore.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: So, I really hope you'll come back and cooperate with us.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Heh... Not gonna lie, that threw me off a bit.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Hehe, you'd be surprised how devoted I am to humanity.
At present. Downtown in the Ark.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: ... And that's how Neo-Neon was born.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hello? Where's my applause and cheers?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Clap, clap, clap.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Woo-hoo!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Wow, thank you, thank you!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: But I definitely went to the Outer Rim to help with Anis's performance, and out of nowhere, crystals started popping up everywhere in the city.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Even I, Neo-Neon, could tell something was really off!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Uh, yeah, I'll fill you in later.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Way too much has gone down, and honestly? The show's the least of our worries right now.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hmm... I see. Looks like I showed up at just the right moment!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Um... Neon?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Thanks a ton for bringing Mrs. Miss.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hehe, no worries!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Just make it up to me with some dance and song.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Yep, got it.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: How heartwarming. I like it.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Excuse me.
Enikk, how's it looking?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: The E2 Crystal terrorist attack has been fully contained.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: 20 Nikkes and 82 civilians are confirmed dead.
Where's Sixo?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: I am currently unable to determine her whereabouts.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Man, this is a pain... What do we do now?
Enikk,
it's safe to say that Sixo can move freely anywhere as long as there's hardware, right?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Not all hardware, but any with a power source and a chipset can be accessed anywhere.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Then why don't we just wreck them all?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: As of now, the number of such hardware within the Ark is in the hundreds of millions. If you include the Outer Rim, it is immeasurable.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Any attempt at destruction is infeasible and would cause irrecoverable damage to the Ark's infrastructure.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: So, what now...?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Calculations for possible courses of actions are in progress.
I've got a suggestion.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_r
lines.text: Please go on.
Let's shut down the Ark.
